value.problem_or_goal: Understanding why Qwen3-8B is performing slowly on specific hardware and comparing it to other models.
value.context: A user is experiencing unexpectedly slow performance with the Qwen3-8B model (Q6_K_L quantization) in LM Studio on a system with a TitanXP (12GB VRAM) and 32GB RAM. The model also exhibits unusual behavior, such as attempting to solve math problems for simple prompts. The user notes that a larger Mistral Nemo Instruct model runs faster.
value.motivation: This question is worth discussing to help the original poster troubleshoot their Qwen3-8B performance issues and to gather insights from the community on potential causes like quantization or configuration problems, especially when compared to other models.
value.desired_response: Community members are encouraged to share their experiences with Qwen3-8B, discuss potential reasons for slow performance and unexpected behavior, and offer advice on troubleshooting or alternative configurations. Comparisons with other models' performance on similar hardware are also welcome.
value.speaker_relationship_to_source: reader of archived source; no claim of personally running reported tests
